### Quarto Book: A Guide to Whole Transcriptome CosMx® SMI Analysis

This is an end-to-end workflow that walks through analyzing a publicly-available WTX single slide dataset -- from loading flat files to quality processing to performing Pathway analysis -- using open-sourced tools in a blend of R and python. 

In here you will find best practices, interactive visualizations to show what effects certain processing parameters have on the data, and applications to cutting-edge tools that have been described in our blog like **HieraType**.

[Start the Guide →](the-wtx-guide/index.html){.btn .btn-primary}
